games.name: Egyptian Legends

board.evaluation: same-symbol count across the board; not adjacent clusters or paylines

symbols.note: Mythic gods are feature characters, not the eight ordinary paying symbol identities.

progress.baseReset: Uncompleted progress is reset before the next base spin.
progress.bonusRetention: Progress survives between free spins; base-game progress is not transferred into the bonus.
progress.featureTiming: Earned features resolve after the current winning cascade sequence; bonus rules explicitly resolve active features before the next free spin.

features.name: Paw of Fortune
features.mechanic: The progress display becomes a growing multiplier bar. Cascade wins use its current multiplier; arriving multiplier-symbol values are added to the bar.

features.name: Scarab Storm
features.mechanic: Multiplier symbols remain on the grid through this feature sequence. At its end, their combined value multiplies the total wins accumulated during the feature.

features.name: Rising Wings
features.mechanic: Multiplier symbols appear at random grid positions. Their summed multiplier applies to each cascade win during the feature and resets when the feature finishes.

features.name: Fate Strike
features.mechanic: Grid-cell multipliers start at 2. Wins involving those cells use the stated sum of multipliers; multipliers on involved cells increase after wins and remain attached to fixed positions for later cascades.
features.unresolved: Help does not specify the numerical increment or fully disambiguate whether the summed multiplier includes only the winning cells or every marked cell.

features.name: Eye of the Sky
features.mechanic: Choose an ordinary symbol type and replace all its visible instances with Wilds. Scatter and Wild cannot be the chosen type. Resulting wins use the current multiplier.

featureSelection.behavior: Chosen feature activates on every spin while selected, replacing the normal progress sequence. Mode changes are allowed only before a new spin, never mid-round or during its bonus.

multiplierSymbols.note: Values and feature descriptions are public; their probabilities and selection distributions are not provided.

unresolved: Exact symbol payout bands and coefficients require the provider GetPayTable response.
Exact feature RNG distributions are private/unexposed.
Bastet per-win multiplier step and Anubis cell increment are not fully specified by the public help.
Marketing calls the five powers by different names and gives a different aggregate RTP; use the runtime mode-specific names and state the source version.

games.name: Olympian Legends

board.evaluation: same-symbol count anywhere on the board; not adjacent clusters or paylines

symbols.note: The runtime normal symbols are two tiers of four colored gems, not Crown/Chalice/Ring/Hourglass.

progress.featureTiming: After the board has no further winning cascades, earned powers play in their fixed order.
progress.baseReset: Base-spin progress resets before the next paid spin.
progress.bonusRetention: Progress persists across bonus spins; base-game progress does not transfer into the bonus.

features.name: Sea Surge
features.mechanic: Remove all low-value symbols. Remaining symbols fall and empty positions refill; the incoming replacements exclude Wild and Scatter.

features.name: Magic Wilds
features.mechanic: Replace random grid positions with 2 to 5 Wilds.

features.name: Globe of Power
features.mechanic: A large symbol lands on random reels and changes into one ordinary symbol to form a winning combination; it cannot become Wild or Scatter.
features.componentEvidence: olympus_rule_component explicitly renders the two Globe description keys.
features.unresolved: The public wording does not specify its exact rectangle dimensions or the selection distribution.

features.name: Forge of Destiny
features.mechanic: Clear and refill 3 to 6 random reels. Wild and Scatter symbols in affected reels survive and fall to the bottom before refill.

features.name: Thunderbolts
features.mechanic: Convert every visible instance of one ordinary symbol type into Wild. Wild and Scatter cannot be the chosen type, and a winning combination cannot consist exclusively of Wilds.

featureMultiplierValues.note: The source has a harmless x10x typographical duplication. Probabilities are not public.

paytableGap.verifiedStructure: Per-symbol configs contain minCount, maxCount and coefficient. Displayed money is coefficient times selected base bet at provider currency precision.
paytableGap.reason: The public static artifacts do not embed the runtime coefficients. An interactive provider demo session was not established past its18+confirmation.
paytableGap.noClaim: Private RNG, reel weights, proprietary RTP math, exact normal-symbol table, and full visual parity are not verified.
